title: Choose a catalog category
responsibility: Maps a unit’s declared kind to its catalog category.

inputs.name: categoryOf.kind
inputs.description: The string is the unit’s declared kind used to choose a catalog category. Only the exact keys `page`, `endpoint`, `api`, `shell`, `layout`, `component`, `function`, `shared-function`, `config`, `service`, and `model` are recognized; all other strings return `null`.

outputs.name: categoryOf
outputs.description: The result is the plural catalog category mapped from the declared kind, or `null` when the kind is not an exact key in the mapping. `function` and `shared-function` both map to `functions`.
